name: Tomas
self_text: I've always loved sketching buildings, and I bring that same appreciation for detail to my gaming on console. These days, it's all Tidewatch for me. I'm mostly into casual matches, where I usually end up in a support role. I'm happy to coach if it helps the team. For communication, I'm on text chat or voice chat. Most weeks, I can be online Saturday afternoon, Sunday afternoon, or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into casual matches. It would be a small bonus if you are the one who gets coached by me, but no big deal.
